snippet.title: Gnaughty Gnomes | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free Gnaughty Gnomes demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454480/Gnaughty_Gnomes/  

Gnaughty Gnomes is a chaotic multiplayer party game where adorable (but deadly) gnomes battle it out using whatever they can find, including each other! Throw objects, choose powerful upgrade cards, and fight to become the gnaughtiest gnome of them all.

🎮 What’s in the demo?
 🗺️ 10 unique maps (5 Aquarium + 5 Airport)
 🃏 45 upgrade cards with synergies and rarities
 🎨 15 customization items per body part
 🏆 3-win matches with upgrades between rounds
📢 We’d love your feedback!

Drop your comments, share your best moments, or let us know if you find any bugs. Your input helps us polish the full game coming in 2025!

And don’t forget to wishlist Gnaughty Gnomes on Steam to stay updated. Thank you!

📧 Press/Creator contact: contact@sandcastlesst.com
